basic_info.description:
Experience luxury living at 1380 Greenwich, Unit 404, a top-floor condo in the heart of coveted Russian Hill. This exquisite 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom residence offers 814 square feet of thoughtfully designed space, featuring a cozy open-concept layout, hardwood floors, and a bright, airy bedroom. Step from the bedroom onto your private deeded deck, which provides direct access to the rooftop terrace boasting breathtaking views of the San Francisco skyline and Golden Gate Bridge, a rare amenity.

With a Walk Score of 97, this home places you steps from Russian Hills top restaurants, boutique shops, and iconic landmarks such as Lombard Street and Fort Mason. Additional conveniences include in-unit laundry, deeded parking, extra storage, and guest parking, making this a truly exceptional find in one of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhoods.
